definitions.explanation: Skill or accomplishment in the arts, especially traditional performing arts. Refers to the refined ability developed through long practice.
A performance, trick, or entertaining act. Used for animal tricks, comedians' routines, and party performances.

examples.japanese: {芸|げい}は{身|み}を{助|たす}ける。
{芸|げい}を{磨|みが}くには{長年|ながねん}の{修行|しゅぎょう}がいる。
examples.english: Polishing one's art takes years of training.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{若|わか}いころから{芸|げい}の{道|みち}に{入|はい}り、{今|いま}では{人間国宝|にんげんこくほう}だ。
examples.english: She entered the world of the arts when she was young, and is now a Living National Treasure.

examples.japanese: うちの{犬|いぬ}は{芸|げい}ができる。
{宴会|えんかい}で{一発芸|いっぱつげい}を{披露|ひろう}した。
examples.english: I performed a party trick at the banquet.

examples.japanese: あのお{笑|わら}い{芸人|げいにん}は{芸|げい}の{幅|はば}が{広|ひろ}くて、{何|なに}をやっても{面白|おもしろ}い。
examples.english: That comedian has a wide range of tricks — everything he does is funny.

notes:
Covers both refined artistic skill and entertaining tricks/performances. The word carries a sense of skill developed through practice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芸|げい}を{磨|みが}く — to polish one's art/skill
- {芸|げい}の{道|みち} — the path of art
- {芸|げい}は{身|み}を{助|たす}ける — a skill can save you (proverb)
- {一発芸|いっぱつげい} — party trick, one-shot performance
- {芸|げい}ができる — can do tricks (animals)
- {芸|げい}が{細|こま}かい — showing fine attention to detail

COMPOUNDS:
- {芸人|げいにん} — entertainer, comedian
- {芸能|げいのう} — performing arts, entertainment
- {芸術|げいじゅつ} — art, fine arts
- {芸者|げいしゃ} — geisha
- {芸名|げいめい} — stage name
- {芸風|げいふう} — artistic style

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {技|わざ} — technique, skill (more physical/martial)
- {芸術|げいじゅつ} — art (more formal, fine arts specifically)
